title: Backfill command: papyrus stories head-index (dry run, idempotent, per site)
description: papyrus stories head-index [--dry-run] [--stage S] [--rate N]: reads the old stage index partition by partition (the one-time migration read, inside a named request_meter sweep), groups rows by lineage, picks the head with the existing _current_of rule (the row marked current; the most recently created if a muddled lineage has several), and writes headStageKey on the head and removes it from any other row. It writes only what differs (re-running writes nothing), passes the row's own updatedAt so no card jumps to the top, writes at a capped rate (default 5 per second), prints one line per change and a summary (lineages, heads set, keys removed, muddled lineages, already correct), and doubles as the verify command (dry run with zero changes = healthy). Per site, through the signed-in papyrus CLI. MoM: about 830 story rows read, one write per lineage that has a stage. Acceptance: dry run on MoM reviewed by Ryan; apply; second dry run reports zero changes; then the same for the other six sites.
